Lines 10c and 10d 0.00. Line 10 = 2,850.00. Line 11 net income = 102,850.00 - 2,850.00 = 100,000.00. Line 12 tax = 100,000.00 x 4.95% = 4,950.0000. Lines 13-18 0.00 (no credits in the projection).
